# ay: SDK, cloud and edge

> ay is the SDK of the Aphrody stack: C ABI, corelib, OpenAPI, design tokens, cloud and edge services. Repository list and release files.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/products/ay/

`ay` is the SDK of the stack, number 3 of 5: C ABI, corelib, OpenAPI, design tokens and the cloud and edge services.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | Aphrody |
| CLI | `ay` |
| Owner | aphrody-labs |
| Root domain | `aphrody.com` |
| npm scope | `@aphrody` |
| Repository | [aphrody-labs/ay](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/ay) |

## Repositories

The stack order is `fw`, `aphrody`, `ay`, `nie`, `shenron`. Every repository of the organization is listed in `ay/ay.toml`.

| Repository | GitHub | Kind |
|---|---|---|
| `fw` | [aphrody-labs/fw](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/fw) | toolchain |
| `aphrody` | [aphrody-labs/aphrody](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/aphrody) | os |
| `ay` | [aphrody-labs/ay](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/ay) | sdk |
| `nie` | [aphrody-labs/nie](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/nie) | game |
| `shenron` | [aphrody-labs/shenron](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/shenron) | site |
| `browser` | [aphrody-labs/browser](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/browser) | browser |
| `bun` | [aphrody-labs/bun](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/bun) | runtime |
| `craft-anything` | [aphrody-labs/craft-anything](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/craft-anything) | craft |
| `fw-nt` | [aphrody-labs/fw-nt](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/fw-nt) | nt |
| `standard` | [aphrody-labs/.github](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/.github) | standard |
| `wiki` | [aphrody-labs/wiki](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/wiki) | library |

## Crates

13 workspace crates live under `ay/crates`. See [the list](/crates/list-ay/).
